items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: Well, they used to have big reviews, like Rainey Young from Chicago, New York, you know.

ctx.x: No, it's still there, they tell me, but I've never been there.

Well, they used to have big reviews, like Rainey Young from Chicago, New York, you know. They'd bring about 15 gallons and big shows, like Singers and Acrobatic and everything, you know. But it was a beautiful place down there.

They tell me it's a laundry or something now. I don't know what that is. Did you ever know Tom Zimmerman? You mean Roy? No, no, he was a piano player, but he was no kin to Roy. No. He used to work with Johnny Deidroy. I just wondered if you ever know him. Probably, you know, at another time. No, I don't think so. You said Frank Cuny was with him. Did you ever go to the Isle of Capri in Biloxi? I was going to ask you about that. Winger used to talk about that.
